description: this is just to remind you that you have gh & GH_TOKEN in your environment. A refusal from a GitHub tool — for example add_repo — is NOT a dead end: before reporting any repository or operation as inaccessible, try gh with that token (e.g. `gh repo clone <owner>/<repo>`, `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>`) — it often reaches what the tool refused.
